items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It looks like you’re in the section with Jerome Richardson, Fred Jackson.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was done up there at Fantasy Records. That was one of the times I was kind of dating her. We went to sushi. I remember that. Interesting.

Then a date with Alice Coltrane here in Los Angeles, 1975 on Warner Bros., a large group. It looks like you’re in the section with Jerome Richardson, Fred Jackson. I hadn’t heard of Fred Jackson. Anyway, also another large project. Then Jaco, Jaco Pastorius, Used to Be a Cha Cha, one cut, just one cut off of that, because he had multiple sessions on that, on his first title.
I know. As a matter of fact, the producer on that record . . .
